test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Complete the collocation.**

I met my professor yesterday and we _______ a long conversation about books and work.
solution:
The correct answer is '**had**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**had**'.
 
• The given sentence is in the **past tense.** Thus, in the underlined part a **past helping verb** will be used.
 
• We know that '**had**' is the past participle of '**have**'.
 
 
• *Example: No more food please - I've **had** enough.*
 
 
 
• We never say 'spoke a long conversation or talked a long conversation' it will make a wrong collocation. Neither do we use 'did' in an assertive sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *I met my professor yesterday and we **had** a long conversation about books and work.*
